anomalies.title: Issuer Technical Failure
anomalies.recommended_action: Route transactions through alternative network if possible, alert ICICI IT infrastructure team regarding weekend downtime.

anomalies.title: Payment Aggregator 3DS Timeout
anomalies.recommended_action: Failover ECOM traffic from PA_03 to redundant aggregators (e.g., PA_01). Investigate PA_03 3DS integration.

anomalies.title: Business Decline (High Value Electronics)
anomalies.recommended_action: Not a technical fault. Offer EMI or Buy-Now-Pay-Later options at checkout for high cart values.
